msg: There are two different coloured baskets which correspond to different coloured gnomes. The yellow basket corresponds to the bright pink, purple, blue, and bright red gnomes. The red basket corresponds to the green, yellow, orange, and soft red gnomes. A high number of mushrooms is 4 or above for any one round, a low number is 3 and below. Select within the basket group of gnome colours until the basket yields 3 or less mushrooms per round, then switch to the other basket group. For example, if your yellow basket yields 5 mushrooms, continue selecting the bright pink, purple, blue, or bright red gnomes until your basket yields 3 or less mushrooms per round. Once that shift occurs, change to selecting gnomes from the red basket group: green, yellow, orange, and soft red gnomes, until the mushroom yield falls to 3 or below.
